declarations.name: Poincare.FiniteAtlasBufferedTensorValue.weighted_transition
declarations.lean_type:
∀ (M : Type u) [TopologicalSpace M]
[ChartedSpace (Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3) M]
[IsManifold (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) ((⊤ : ENat) : WithTop ENat) M]
(A : Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.AtlasData M)
(ξ : Fin A.cover.chartCount → Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3 → ℝ)
(W : Fin A.cover.chartCount → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3 → ℝ),
∀ (i k : Fin A.cover.chartCount) (a b : Fin 3) (x : M),
x ∈ (Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.chart A i).source → x ∈ (Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.chart A k).source →
A.partition k x * Poincare.FiniteAtlasBufferedTensorValue.value A ξ W i a b x =
A.partition i x * ∑ p : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3,
 (Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.jac A i k x p a * Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.jac A i k x q b) * Poincare.FiniteAtlasBufferedTensorValue.value A ξ W k p q x

declarations.name: Poincare.FiniteAtlasBufferedTensorValue.symmetric
declarations.lean_type:
∀ (M : Type u) [TopologicalSpace M]
[ChartedSpace (Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3) M]
[IsManifold (Poincare.closedSmoothModelWithCorners 3) ((⊤ : ENat) : WithTop ENat) M]
(A : Poincare.FiniteAtlasParabolicTensorSpace.AtlasData M)
(ξ : Fin A.cover.chartCount → Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3 → ℝ)
(W : Fin A.cover.chartCount → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Poincare.ClosedSmoothModel 3 → ℝ),
(∀ j a b z, W j a b z = W j b a z) →
∀ i a b x, Poincare.FiniteAtlasBufferedTensorValue.value A ξ W i a b x = Poincare.FiniteAtlasBufferedTensorValue.value A ξ W i b a x
